summary: The blocking finding is valid. The current workflow plugin command help surface in this repository does not include refine, and changing the workflow plugin snapshot is explicitly out of scope.

items.title: Required refine subcommand is not in the workflow command help surface
items.rationale: The spec should match the command help emitted by the installed workflow plugin command. Requiring refine would force an out-of-scope plugin snapshot change or a failing acceptance test.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0] identifies that helpText() and publicSurface include add, update, show, search, list, publish, and ideas. .senti/plugins/workflow/commands/workflow.js confirms publicSurface and helpText() have no refine entry.
